name: wod5e
description: ESLint & other utiltiies for developing World of Darkness 5e

scripts.convert-conditions: fvtt package unpack -n Conditions --inputDirectory ./packs/ --outputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_conditions && fvtt package pack -n Conditions --inputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_conditions --outputDirectory ./packs --nedb
scripts.convert-macros: fvtt package unpack -n Macros --inputDirectory ./packs/ --outputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_macros && fvtt package pack -n Macros --inputDirectory ./packs/unpacked/_macros --outputDirectory ./packs --nedb
scripts.convert-packs: npm run convert-conditions && npm run convert-macros

author: Veilza
